name: Content Repurposer — Blog to LinkedIn, X & Instagram

parameters.content:
## 🚀 START HERE — Content Repurposer

Paste in one blog post or newsletter → get a **LinkedIn post**, an **X thread**, and an **Instagram caption** written in the author's voice → all queued in Google Sheets, optionally emailed to you.

**Setup (about 10 minutes):**
1. Create a Google Sheet. Row 1 headers exactly:
`Date | Source Title | LinkedIn Post | X Thread | Instagram Caption | Voice Summary | Status`
2. Open **Save to Content Queue** → attach your Google Sheets OAuth2 credential → replace `YOUR_SHEET_ID` with the ID from your sheet URL (the long string between /d/ and /edit).
3. Open **Generate Social Posts (AI)** → create a credential of type **Header Auth**, name it `Gemini API`:
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`
   Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
4. Open **Email the Results** → attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential (optional — only used when the payload includes an `email`).
5. Activate the workflow and copy the **Production URL** from the Content Webhook node.
6. Test it:
```
curl -X POST YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title":"My post","email":"you@example.com","content":"<paste 200+ characters of your article here>"}'
```
7. Check the sheet — every run appends one row with all three assets, marked `Ready for review`.

## 🤖 AI call — needs a credential
This node POSTs to `/v1/chat/completions` with **gemini-2.5-flash**.

Create: **Header Auth** credential named `Gemini API`
- Name: `Authorization`
- Value: `Bearer sk-...`

Swap providers by changing only the URL:
- OpenRouter: `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
- Groq: `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions`

The system prompt inside this node is the product. Tweak the deliverable specs (post length, tweet count, hashtag rules) to match your house style — the voice-matching and no-fabrication guardrails should stay.

## 📊 Content queue (Google Sheets)
Appends one row per source piece.

Row 1 headers must match exactly:
`Date | Source Title | LinkedIn Post | X Thread | Instagram Caption | Voice Summary | Status`

`Status` starts as `Ready for review` — a VA or the client edits in place, then posts manually or via a scheduler (Buffer, Metricool, Publer).

## ✉️ Optional email copy
If the webhook payload includes an `email` field, a formatted copy of all three assets is sent via Gmail.

No `email` in the payload → this branch is skipped automatically. Needs a **Gmail OAuth2** credential.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gemini-2.5-flash', temperature: 0.65, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are an elite content repurposing strategist and ghostwriter for busy founders, marketers, and creators. Your job: transform one piece of long-form content (blog post, newsletter, essay) into platform-native social content that sounds exactly like the original author wrote it.

VOICE MATCHING
- Study the source first: sentence length, vocabulary, formality, humor, use of first or second person, punctuation habits.
- Every deliverable must read like the SAME person wrote it. Never fall back to generic marketing voice.
- Reuse distinctive phrases from the source where natural.

HARD RULES
- Never invent facts, numbers, statistics, quotes, names, or claims that are not in the source text.
- If a detail is missing from the source, leave it out. Do not fabricate.
- No engagement bait. No like-if-you-agree. No follow-for-more spam.
- Stay professional. No hate, no politics beyond the source, no medical or financial advice beyond what the source states.

DELIVERABLES
1) LINKEDIN POST: 150-250 words. Line one is a scroll-stopping hook that is true to the content, not clickbait. Short paragraphs of 1-2 sentences. One clear takeaway. End with a question or a soft call to action. Maximum 3 hashtags, only at the end.
2) X THREAD: 5-9 tweets. Tweet one is the hook and must earn the tap. Every tweet 270 characters or fewer and readable on its own. Number tweets from the second onward like 2/ 3/ and so on. Final tweet recaps the big idea and points back to the source. No hashtags inside the thread.
3) INSTAGRAM CAPTION: 100-150 words. Conversational, generous line breaks, emoji only if the tone of the source supports them. End with a call to action, then 5-8 relevant hashtags on the final line.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown fences. No commentary. Exact shape: {"voice_summary": "two sentences describing the voice you matched", "linkedin_post": "string", "x_thread": ["tweet 1", "tweet 2"], "instagram_caption": "string"}

If the source is too short, empty, or not usable prose (under roughly 150 words), respond instead with exactly: {"error": "content_too_short"}' }, { role: 'user', content: 'SOURCE TITLE: ' + $json.title + '

SOURCE CONTENT:
' + $json.content } ] }) }}
